transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. To start, can you tell me what's been bringing you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess it's mostly work stuff. I just keep making these... dumb mistakes on my sales reports. Like copying the wrong numbers from the team dashboard, or... missing a line in a procedure I'm supposed to check. Even when I thought I went over it. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you noticed these kinds of careless mistakes and concentration slips going back to childhood or your school years, or is this something that's really only started recently?

Um... no, it's not recent. I guess I was kind of like this as a kid, too. 

My mom actually still brings up these old teacher notes she got back in elementary school. Just... saying I rushed through my work, or lost my homework. And... I guess I talked out of turn a lot. Couldn't really stay in my seat without them reminding me. So... yeah. Always been kind of like that, I guess.
Aside from these concentration and follow-through issues, have you been experiencing ongoing low mood, loss of interest in things you used to enjoy, or excessive worry over the past few weeks?
No, not really. I mean, work is stressful, but... I don't feel down or anything. Just frustrated with myself. And I don't really worry about things more than usual. So... no, nothing like that.
Do you currently notice yourself feeling restless, fidgeting a lot, or having trouble sitting still during meetings or long tasks?

Yeah, I guess so. Um... sitting through those long sales meetings is... it's tough. It kind of feels like my body is just... buzzing inside, I guess. I end up shifting around a lot, or... tapping my foot. Sometimes I just make up an excuse to get up and leave the room for a minute. So... yeah.
Outside of work, do you notice these same kinds of concentration slips or restlessness causing problems at home or in your personal life, like with relationships, chores, or managing finances?

Yeah, it happens at home, too. Um... it causes some arguments, I guess. People say I don't follow through on things, so... they feel like they can't count on me. And, um... work isn't great either. My manager actually brought it up in my last formal review. So... yeah, it's definitely causing some issues.
Do you often find yourself interrupting others, blurting out answers before someone finishes speaking, or making quick decisions without thinking them through?

Yeah, sometimes. Um... mostly in meetings. I just... I jump in before people are done talking. I usually think I know where they're going with it, so... I just say it. But then sometimes I realize I answered the wrong point, or... I just cut them off. So, yeah, I do that.
